alex_dev: Heads-up — PR #17244 is stuck in the macOS CI queue, failing the integration test `TestFileSync` repeatedly. Need to merge before the maintenance blackout Mon 14:00 UTC. Can we get a short rebase/merge window on Sunday morning?

maya_pe: I can eyeball the test. Can you paste the flaky failure log (last ~50 lines)?

alex_dev: pasted below — failing assertion on file checksum after the sync step. happened 3 runs in a row.
```
--- FAIL: TestFileSync (0.27s)
    sync_test.go:112: expected checksum 0x1a2b3c4d, got 0x00000000
    --- FAIL: TestFileSync/remove-temp-files (0.03s)

panic: timeout waiting for file watch event

goroutine 27 [running]:
testing.tRunner(0xc0000b2000, 0x10a7b40)
	/usr/local/go/src/testing/testing.go:966 +0x123
created by testing.(*T).Run
	/usr/local/go/src/testing/testing.go:1037 +0x66
```

sam_sre: CI backlogs are high right now — macOS runners are ~20 queued. If we want a guaranteed merge we can request a rebase slot (Sunday 10:00 UTC) or mark the PR as priority for a manual rerun. @julie_release any objections to a short Sunday slot? :clock10: 

julie_release: Sunday 10:00 UTC works for me as long as we keep it minimal (one PR, manual canary). Add a rollback plan in the PR description and ping infra if runners flake.

alex_dev: OK will add rollback steps and label `needs-eyes + rebase-slot`. Can someone trigger a rerun while I prep the rebase? Command I usually run: `./ci retry --job=macos-integration --pr=17244`

ci-bot: Job queued: macos-integration (PR #17244). Position in queue: 18. ETA ~2h 10m. If you need priority, request `rebase-slot` and mention @eng-release for manual intervention.

maya_pe: I'll take a quick look at the failing assertion now. If it's the checksum path we saw last week, rebase + regenerate fixtures should fix it.

sam_sre: Note — if we decide on the Sunday slot, please update the release calendar and set the `no-auto-merge` flag after rebase until we've validated the canary. I'll be on-call and can help promote once green.

alex_dev: Thanks — will rebase tonight, add rollback steps, and DM @sam_sre when ready for the manual rerun. Scheduling: request rebase slot Sun 10:00 UTC, canary run Sun 10:10 UTC, promote Sun 10:30 UTC if green.

julie_release: Sounds good. Add a short blurb in the PR: why this can't wait, what steps you took, and how to revert. :thumbsup:

alex_dev: Done. pinging here again when I finish the rebase. Appreciate the quick help!
